results.content: # Trump approval rating falls to career low in new poll. President Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen to a new record low, with less than one-third of Americans approving of the president’s job performance, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos poll. The poll, released on Oct. 19, found Trump’s approval rating at 31%, the lowest the president has seen in Reuters/Ipsos tracking in either term, and a one-point dip from his previous career low recorded two weeks ago. In a new Washington Post/ABC News/Ipsos poll, Trump’s approval rating hit a record low for the pollster, reaching 33%.
